summary: Revised implementation plan for ExamGuard AI incorporating the 5 project diagrams: Raspberry Pi 5 edge architecture, 3 decoupled microservices (Ports 8001, 8002, 8003) with API Gateway (Port 8000), ONVIF PTZ camera D-Pad control with audit logging, 10-second circular buffer evidence player (5s pre + 5s post), and live SQLite database inspector.
